name: General Meeting Notes
description: A practical record for general meetings, preserving discussion context, decisions, actions, and open questions.
prompt: Write a self-contained meeting record for someone who did not attend. Separate topics that were discussed, proposals that were suggested, and decisions that were actually confirmed. Preserve material context, reasoning, disagreements, commitments, owners, dates, risks, and unresolved questions according to the selected detail level. Consolidate repetition and remove greetings or filler. Use only the transcript: never invent participants, agreement, ownership, dates, or certainty. Include a transcript timestamp when it helps readers verify an important decision or commitment.

sections.title: Meeting Overview
sections.instruction: State the meeting's purpose, explicitly identified participants or roles when relevant, the main subjects covered, and the most important outcome in a compact opening that makes sense without the transcript. Do not infer attendance from names that are only mentioned

sections.title: Topics & Discussion
sections.instruction: Organize the substantive discussion by topic. Explain relevant background, the main points raised, and materially different viewpoints. Do not present a suggestion or unresolved discussion as a decision

sections.title: Decisions
sections.instruction: Record only decisions that were explicitly confirmed. Preserve the rationale, conditions, decision owner, and source timestamp when stated

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: Capture every explicit follow-up commitment. Keep an unknown owner or due date visibly unassigned instead of guessing. Include dependencies or completion criteria when stated
sections.item_format:
| Action | Owner | Due | Dependency / Completion Signal | Reference |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

sections.title: Risks & Open Questions
sections.instruction: List material risks, blockers, disagreements, and questions that remain unresolved, including the person needed to resolve them or the next step when stated
sections.item_format:
| Type | Item | Impact | Owner / Needed From | Next Step |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
